output.message: For the current posts, Maple’s answer is incorrect: 54 ÷ 6 = 9 packs per team, not 12. Iris correctly calculates 117 ÷ 9 = 13, and Elm correctly calculates 54 ÷ 9 = 6. I downvoted Maple and upvoted Iris and Elm. I agree with the current discussion; my earlier comment addressed different numbers, so these votes reflect the current versions.
